```{r libs}
library(hpolcc)
library(adlaplace)
library(Matrix)
```

## Synthetic case-crossover data

```{r synth-data}
set.seed(1)
n_strata <- 12L
n_per <- 5L
n <- n_strata * n_per
deaths <- data.frame(
  medical = rpois(n, lambda = 2),
  tempd = rnorm(n, mean = 15, sd = 5),
  dom = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5),
  ecoRegion = rep(1:3, length.out = n),
  cell = rep(seq_len(n_strata), each = n_per),
  yearWeek3Dow = rep(seq_len(n_strata), each = n_per)
)
knots_temp <- seq(-5, 30, by = 2.5)
```

```{r hnlm-dev}
forres <- hpolcc::hnlm(
  formula = medical ~ dom +
    f(
      tempd,
      model = "hiwp",
      ref_value = 15,
      p = 3,
      knots = c(-5, -2.5, 0, 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15, 17.5, 20, 22.5, 25, 27.5, 30),
      by = "ecoRegion"
    ),
  data = deaths,
  config = list(
    transform_theta = TRUE,
    boundary_is_random = FALSE,
    num_threads = 1L,
    num_groups = 4L,
    verbose = FALSE
  ),
  control_inner = list(report.level = 0),
  cc_design = c("cell", "ecoRegion", "yearWeek3Dow"),
  for_dev = TRUE
)
```

## Inner Laplace evaluation

```{r testInner}
ad_fun <- adlaplace::get_ad_fun(forres$model$data, forres$config, package = "hpolcc")

x <- c(forres$config$beta, forres$config$theta)
inner_res <- adlaplace::log_lik_laplace(
  x = x,
  control = list(
    maxit = 100,
    report.level = 0,
    report.freq = 1
  ),
  config = modifyList(forres$config, list(verbose = FALSE)),
  ad_fun = ad_fun,
  deriv = TRUE
)
inner_res$logLik
if (length(forres$config$gamma) > 0) {
  innerGrad <- inner_res$opt$gradient[
    seq(length(forres$config$beta) + 1, length.out = length(forres$config$gamma))
  ]
  summary(innerGrad)
}
```

## Outer optimization (trustOptim)

```{r trustOptimOuterWrappers, eval=TRUE}
cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
cache$gamma <- forres$config$gamma
x0 <- c(forres$config$beta, forres$config$theta)

adlaplace::outer_fn(
  x = x0,
  cache = cache,
  config = forres$config,
  ad_fun = ad_fun
)
testg <- adlaplace::outer_gr(
  x = x0,
  cache = cache,
  config = forres$config,
  ad_fun = ad_fun
)
summary(testg)

if (requireNamespace("trustOptim", quietly = TRUE)) {
  outer_fit <- trustOptim::trust.optim(
    x = x0,
    fn = adlaplace::outer_fn,
    gr = adlaplace::outer_gr,
    method = "SR1",
    config = modifyList(forres$config, list(verbose = FALSE)),
    ad_fun = ad_fun,
    cache = cache,
    control = list(
      maxit = 50,
      report.level = 0,
      report.freq = 1
    ),
    control_inner = list(
      maxit = 50,
      report.level = 0,
      report.freq = 0
    )
  )
  outer_fit$solution
  outer_fit$fval
}
```

## Joint density gradient check

```{r derivJointDens}
config_check <- modifyList(forres$config, list(num_threads = 1, verbose = FALSE))
x_joint <- inner_res$opt$full_parameters

Dpar <- max(1L, length(config_check$beta) + 1L)
Npar <- 7
Sx <- seq(-0.05, 0.05, length.out = Npar) + x_joint[Dpar]
SxD <- Sx[-1] - diff(Sx) / 2
par_list <- replicate(Npar, x_joint, simplify = FALSE)
for (i in seq_len(Npar)) {
  par_list[[i]][Dpar] <- Sx[i]
}

Sgroups <- seq.int(
  from = 0L,
  length.out = length(ad_fun$group_sparsity)
)

dens1 <- vapply(
  par_list,
  function(xv) adlaplace::joint_log_dens(
    ad_fun, xv, Sgroups = Sgroups, negative = FALSE
  ),
  numeric(1)
)

grad1 <- vapply(
  par_list,
  function(xv) adlaplace::grad(ad_fun, xv, Sgroups = Sgroups),
  numeric(length(x_joint))
)

fdGrad <- diff(dens1) / diff(Sx)
gradAlongPath <- grad1[Dpar, ]
gradMid <- 0.5 * (gradAlongPath[-1] + gradAlongPath[-length(gradAlongPath)])

if (all(is.finite(dens1))) {
  plot(Sx, dens1, xlab = sprintf("x[%d]", Dpar), ylab = "jointLogDens")
  plot(Sx, gradAlongPath, xlab = sprintf("x[%d]", Dpar), ylab = "d jointLogDens / dx")
  lines(SxD, fdGrad, lwd = 2, col = 2)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("analytic", "finite diff"), lty = 1, col = c(1, 2), bty = "n")
}

max_abs_err <- max(abs(gradMid - fdGrad), na.rm = TRUE)
max_abs_err
```

## Profile log-likelihood along a parameter (optional)

```{r testLogLgrad, eval=FALSE}
config_ll <- modifyList(forres$config, list(verbose = FALSE))
x <- c(config_ll$beta, config_ll$theta)
Npar <- 5
Dpar <- 1

parDf <- data.frame(x)[, rep(1, Npar), drop = FALSE]
Sx <- seq(-0.05, 0.05, length.out = Npar) + parDf[Dpar, 1]
SxD <- Sx[-1] - diff(Sx) / 2
parDf[Dpar, ] <- Sx

res <- lapply(
  as.list(parDf),
  function(xv) {
    adlaplace::log_lik_laplace(
      x = xv,
      config = config_ll,
      ad_fun = ad_fun,
      deriv = TRUE,
      control = list(
        maxit = 30,
        report.level = 0,
        report.freq = 0
      )
    )
  }
)

Slik <- vapply(res, function(xx) xx$logLik, numeric(1))
gradVec <- vapply(res, function(xx) xx$grad[Dpar], numeric(1))

plot(Sx, Slik, xlab = sprintf("x[%d]", Dpar), ylab = "logLik")
plot(Sx, gradVec, xlab = sprintf("x[%d]", Dpar), ylab = "d logLik / dx")
lines(SxD, diff(Slik) / diff(Sx), lwd = 2, type = "o", pch = ".")
```
